g.text: Causal parent retention, GHOST identity, and certified-floor replay
retain only tips descending from F
add F when no causal candidate descends from F
narrow recovery only if main covers
live tips and descends from F
D remains causal input but has no vote after F finalizes. If D expires from
the live parent horizon it still remains an exact evidence root. Deploy policy
cannot replace the GHOST main parent, and no merge rejection may erase an
effect already represented by the certified floor.
alternate snapshot has only stale disjoint tips
